note: Downstream-recompile predicate for #5292, distinct from match.json. match.json's structural regex scores the REWRITER's own output text (a rewritten-HLSL snippet) and is meaningless applied here, because these two captures instead feed a fixed piece of HLSL straight to dxc.exe -T ps_6_0 -E ps_main and the interesting observation is only whether that ordinary compile succeeds or fails -- so this predicate is exit-code-based, using triage.py's existing 'nonzero_exit' kind (already defined in scripts/triage.py, reused verbatim, not a new predicate mechanism). 'match' = dxc.exe fails to compile (nonzero exit): rewritten-buggy.hlsl (dxr's actual rewrite of repro.hlsl, retaining the dangling `typedef PSOutput PSPointOutput;` after `struct PSOutput {};` was removed) is expected here, reproducing notes.md's 'Downstream recompile' finding verbatim (exit 0x80004005 / -2147467259, 'unknown type name' diagnostics). 'no-match' = a clean compile (exit 0): variant-recompile.hlsl -- the same source *unrewritten* (identical to rewritten-buggy.hlsl's input except it still has both struct definitions) -- is the control proving the failure is caused by the rewrite step and not by the `: SV_Target` semantic added only so the unrewritten source is itself a valid, compilable pixel shader.
